description_de: Das Cube Kathmandu Hybrid SLT 800 Trapez ist ein E-Trekkingbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist, bedient wird er über Bosch Kiox 500. Federung: Fox 34 Float AWL, 2-Position Sweep-Adjust RAIL Damper, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 100mm. Schaltung: Shimano XT Di2 RD-M8260-SGS, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Bremsen: Shimano XT ABS, Front 4-Piston/Rear 4-Piston, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Rahmen: Aluminium Superlite. Erhältlich in den Größen 46 cm, 50 cm, 54 cm, 58 cm.
description_en: The Cube Kathmandu Hybrid SLT 800 Trapez is an electric trekking bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery, controlled via Bosch Kiox 500. Suspension: Fox 34 Float AWL, 2-Position Sweep-Adjust RAIL Damper, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 100mm. Drivetrain: Shimano XT Di2 RD-M8260-SGS, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Brakes: Shimano XT ABS, Front 4-Piston/Rear 4-Piston, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Frame: Aluminium Superlite. Available in sizes 46 cm, 50 cm, 54 cm, 58 cm.
motorDetails: Bosch Drive Unit Performance Line CX max. 120Nm (BDU38), ABS
